thread:
kai: FYI seeing burst of 403s from auth-proxy this morning after the RBAC changes. Affected flows are SSO sign-ons and service tokens used by UI apps.
maria: Can you paste the proxy log snippet and which IdP claims are in the assertion?
kai: Log: `2026-03-10T07:12:33Z auth-proxy WARN req=6f5a user=bob@example.com idp_err=InvalidAudience aud=\"https://console.redwood.example.com/api/v1\" svc_token_err=KMSDecryptError: context_mismatch ctx_keys=[\"team\",\"externalId\"] alias=\"alias/redwood-prod-v3\"`
lena: We rolled the RBAC bindings for team=edge at 02:00 and bumped the SAML connector yesterday. Could be a claim mapping regression.
oliver: I checked KMS rotation timeline — alias/redwood-prod-v3 rotated 2026-03-09T23:50:00Z. Metadata shows encryption_context keys set to {"team":"lowercase","externalId":"normalized"} when tokens were minting. If SCIM now sends ExternalID with capitals, decrypt will fail.
jamie: Quick hunt query: `SELECT id, payload->>'externalId' AS ext FROM scim_changes WHERE created_at > '2026-03-09' AND payload->>'externalId' ~ '[A-Z]';` returned ~12 users and 3 svc accounts.
maria: Two vectors here: 1) IdP/SAML normalization -> Audience/Issuer mismatch (InvalidAudience) 2) token JWE context mismatch because extId case changed. Need to triage both.
kai: Reproduced locally by minting token with ExternalID="SvcAcctX" then trying to decrypt with context extid lowercase. Fails.
lena: Short-term mitigation: auth-proxy can try alternate context derivation (lowercase extId) when KMS returns context_mismatch. Implement as a canary flag.
oliver: Prefer making the token generator tolerant instead of widening decrypt consumers. But generator touches many services. Shim in proxy is lower-risk and contained. Agree to canary.
maria: Also check SAML Audience: previous audience was `https://redwood.example.com/sso` but new connector uses full hostname with /api. If IdP is asserting the old audience, SAML validation will produce InvalidAudience. We should add a compatible audience check for legacy values as fallback for a short window.
jamie: I'll open a tiny change: 1) proxy shim to try lowercase extId on decrypt error, 2) add legacy audience acceptance. Will post PR to canary in 10m.
kai: Create incident: https://incidents/redwood/INC-2026-079 — tagging sec oncall. Please attach KMS and SCIM audits.
sec-bot: KMS audit: alias/redwood-prod-v3 rotated -> key id ef56cd90 at 2026-03-09T23:50:00Z. No immediate decrypt errors reported in rotation logs. SCIM audit: connector v2.4.1 deployed at 2026-03-09T22:45:00Z changed mapping for `externalId` -> `ExternalID` (case preserved).
lena: Plan: (A) Jamie deploys shim to canary (10:20 PT). (B) Run backfill to normalize externalId to lowercase for team=edge (lena). (C) Short audit of role-binding cache keys; flush caches if required (kai). (D) Add Redwood Console alert for KMS decrypt rate + SAML validation error spikes (maria).
oliver: I'll review KMS access policies to confirm we didn't add a stricter encryption_context matcher by mistake. If necessary, we can publish a temporary tolerant policy for legacy tokens but prefer code shim.
jamie: PR: https://github.com/redwood/auth-proxy/pull/392 — includes feature flag `legacy_extid_fallback`. Will canary to 5% first.
kai: Monitoring: 403 rate down from 120/min -> 14/min after enabling canary (partial). Rolling out to 25% now.
maria: Reminder: avoid long-lived policy changes in KMS; any policy loosen must be scoped and temporary. Create RFC for SCIM canonicalization.
lena: Backfill started: `UPDATE users SET external_id = lower(external_id) WHERE team = 'edge' AND external_id ~ '[A-Z]';` Running as low-priority job.
sec-bot: Incident INC-2026-079 created, severity P2. Assigned: jamie, lena, kai, oliver. Paste KMS and SCIM audit links in incident doc.
kai: Thanks all. If we still see InvalidAudience, open a separate thread for SAML connector rollback. For now focus on KMS extId casing and RBAC cache flush.
maria: Agreed. Will draft the SCIM canonicalization RFC and include migration plan + tests.
oliver: After backfill completes we'll re-mint service tokens for affected svc accounts to avoid future decrypt attempts hitting legacy tokens.
jamie: Will post canary results in 30m. Ping me in #eng-oncall if you see regressions.
kai: Closing loop here; follow-ups in incident doc. :white_check_mark:
